claims.claim: urllib3 fixed response header handling to replace obsolete folded header lines (`obs-fold`) with spaces in accordance with RFC 9112.
claims.citation: Fixed response header handling to replace obsolete folded header lines (`obs-fold`) with spaces in accordance with RFC 9112

claims.claim: Replacing obsolete folded header lines (`obs-fold`) with spaces in urllib3 response header handling prevents raw CRLF sequences from appearing in header values such as `Set-Cookie`.
claims.citation: preventing raw CRLF sequences from appearing in header values such as `Set-Cookie`

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed usage of `proxy_ssl_context` with `ProxyManager` when `use_forwarding_for_https=True`.
claims.citation: Fixed usage of `proxy_ssl_context` with `ProxyManager` when `use_forwarding_for_https=True`

claims.claim: Passing `ssl_context` instead of `proxy_ssl_context` for HTTPS proxies when `use_forwarding_for_https=True` in urllib3 now emits a `FutureWarning`.
claims.citation: Passing `ssl_context` instead of `proxy_ssl_context` for HTTPS proxies in this configuration now emits a `FutureWarning`

claims.claim: Passing `ssl_context` instead of `proxy_ssl_context` for HTTPS proxies when `use_forwarding_for_https=True` in urllib3 will raise an error in v3.0.
claims.citation: will raise an error in v3.0

claims.claim: urllib3 changed the behavior of the default `ConnectionPool.pool` initialization.
claims.citation: Changed behavior of the default `ConnectionPool.pool` initialization

claims.claim: In urllib3, `LifoQueue` is now resolved from the `queue` module after the `ConnectionPool` is instantiated instead of using the default cached `QueueCls` class property.
claims.citation: `LifoQueue` is now resolved from the `queue` module after the `ConnectionPool` is instantiated instead of using the default cached `QueueCls` class property

claims.claim: The `queue.LifoQueue` is sometimes monkey-patched late in a program, such as by gevent.
claims.citation: sometimes the `queue.LifoQueue` is monkey-patched late in the program, such as by gevent

claims.claim: urllib3 raised `UnrewindableBodyError` instead of `ValueError` when retrying a request whose body had `tell()` but not `seek()`.
claims.citation: Raised `UnrewindableBodyError` instead of `ValueError` when retrying a request whose body had `tell()` but not `seek()`

claims.claim: urllib3 decoded percent-encoded SOCKS proxy credentials before authenticating with the proxy server.
claims.citation: Decoded percent-encoded SOCKS proxy credentials before authenticating with the proxy server

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `HTTPResponse.drain_conn()` to discard unread response data in 64 KiB chunks.
claims.citation: Fixed `HTTPResponse.drain_conn()` to discard unread response data in 64 KiB chunks

claims.claim: The default `amt` when calling `HTTPResponse.stream(...)` in urllib3 is 64 KiB.
claims.citation: default `amt` when doing `HTTPResponse.stream(...)`

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `is_ipaddress()` to detect non-standard IPv4 forms accepted by `socket.connect`, such as hex (`0x7f000001`), octal (`0177.0.0.1`), and decimal integers (`2130706433`).
claims.citation: Fixed `is_ipaddress()` to detect non-standard IPv4 forms accepted by `socket.connect`, such as hex (`0x7f000001`), octal (`0177.0.0.1`), and decimal integers (`2130706433`)

claims.claim: Detecting non-standard IPv4 forms in `is_ipaddress()` ensures SSL certificate verification uses the correct mode for these addresses.
claims.citation: ensuring SSL certificate verification uses the correct mode for these addresses

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen` raising a misleading `FullPoolError` instead of `ValueError` when called with an invalid `timeout` argument on a pool created with `block=True`.
claims.citation: Fixed `HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen` raising a misleading `FullPoolError` instead of `ValueError` when called with an invalid `timeout` argument on a pool created with `block=True`

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed port-zero handling to preserve explicit `:0` values instead of substituting default ports 80 or 443 in URL parsing, pool selection, proxy configuration, `connection_from_url()`, and HTTP/2 request authority.
claims.citation: Fixed port-zero handling to preserve explicit `:0` values instead of substituting the default ports 80 or 443 in URL parsing, pool selection, proxy configuration, `connection_from_url()`, and HTTP/2 request authority

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed a bug where `PoolManager` passed the `assert_hostname` and `assert_fingerprint` parameters to HTTP connection pools.
claims.citation: Fixed a bug where `PoolManager` passed the `assert_hostname` and `assert_fingerprint` parameters to HTTP connection pools

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen()` and HTTP proxy forwarding to strip URL fragments from absolute request targets before sending requests.
claims.citation: Fixed `HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen()` and HTTP proxy forwarding to strip URL fragments from absolute request targets before sending requests

claims.claim: urllib3 added safeguards to the proxy tunneling code to prevent potential security issues when handling invalid characters in the proxy host and HTTP headers.
claims.citation: Added safeguards to the proxy tunneling code to prevent potential security issues when handling invalid characters in the proxy host and HTTP headers

claims.claim: The proxy tunneling safeguards change in urllib3 affects users of Python 3.10, Python 3.11, and Python 3.12 when the standard library does not contain the fix.
claims.citation: This change affects users of Python 3.10, Python 3.11, and Python 3.12 when the standard library does not contain the fix

claims.claim: Users on newer Python versions should upgrade to Python 3.13.14+ or 3.14.5+ to get the standard library security fixes.
claims.citation: those on newer Python versions should upgrade to 3.13.14+ or 3.14.5+ to get the same security fixes

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `HTTPSConnection.connect()` overriding `ProxyConfig.ssl_context`'s certificate policy and proxy identity checks with the target connection's TLS settings when forwarding through an HTTPS proxy.
claims.citation: Fixed `HTTPSConnection.connect()` overriding `ProxyConfig.ssl_context`'s certificate policy and proxy identity checks with the target connection's TLS settings when forwarding through an HTTPS proxy

claims.claim: `HTTPSConnection` no longer applies target SNI, assertions, or client credentials to forwarding proxy handshakes.
claims.citation: `HTTPSConnection` no longer applies target SNI, assertions, or client credentials to forwarding proxy handshakes

claims.claim: `HTTPSConnection` continues to use its `ssl_context` as a fallback when an HTTPS proxy forwards an HTTP target.
claims.citation: continues to use its `ssl_context` as a fallback when an HTTPS proxy forwards an HTTP target

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed URL parsing to more strictly enforce RFC 3986 host syntax, rejecting invalid host input such as raw spaces and control characters, malformed percent-encodings, and percent-encoded control characters in HTTP(S) hosts and IPv6 zone identifiers, including proxy CONNECT tunnel targets.
claims.citation: Fixed URL parsing to more strictly enforce RFC 3986 host syntax, rejecting invalid host input such as raw spaces and control characters, malformed percent-encodings, and percent-encoded control characters in HTTP(S) hosts and IPv6 zone identifiers, including proxy CONNECT tunnel targets

claims.claim: Host normalization in urllib3 now follows RFC 3986 normalization rules for percent-encoded octets by decoding percent-encoded unreserved characters.
claims.citation: Host normalization now also follows RFC 3986 normalization rules for percent-encoded octets by decoding percent-encoded unreserved characters

claims.claim: Host normalization in urllib3 now follows RFC 3986 normalization rules for percent-encoded octets by uppercasing the hexadecimal digits of retained percent-encoded octets.
claims.citation: uppercasing the hexadecimal digits of retained percent-encoded octets

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed an `AttributeError` on Python built with OpenSSL 4+, where `ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1` no longer exists.
claims.citation: Fixed an `AttributeError` on Python built with OpenSSL 4+, where `ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1` no longer exists

claims.claim: In Python built with OpenSSL 4+, `ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1` no longer exists.
claims.citation: Python built with OpenSSL 4+, where `ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1` no longer exists

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl` to use cryptography APIs when reading a certificate subject and loading encrypted private keys, avoiding `DeprecationWarning` raised by pyOpenSSL 26.3.0+.
claims.citation: Fixed `urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl` to use cryptography APIs when reading a certificate subject and loading encrypted private keys, avoiding `DeprecationWarning` raised by pyOpenSSL 26.3.0+

claims.claim: pyOpenSSL 26.3.0+ raises a `DeprecationWarning` when reading a certificate subject and loading encrypted private keys.

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed handling of HTTP 303 redirects for requests with chunked or file-like bodies.
claims.citation: Fixed handling of HTTP 303 redirects for requests with chunked or file-like bodies

claims.claim: urllib3 fixed `assert_fingerprint()` to raise `SSLError` instead of `binascii.Error` when a fingerprint has a supported length but contains non-hexadecimal characters.
